name: Outlook
description: Connect Hotmail / Outlook.com / Live independently to search, read, list folders, draft, send, and delete mail. Only mail permissions are requested; Cindy hosts authorization. Sending and deleting require explicit user intent.
whenToUse: Use this plugin to search Hotmail / Outlook.com, read bodies, list folders, save drafts, send, or delete mail. First connect Hotmail on this plugin details page.

outlook_accounts.description: List Outlook / Hotmail accounts connected to this plugin and their status. Authorize first on the Outlook plugin details page.

outlook.description: Run Outlook mail operations: search or list recent messages, read, list folders, save drafts, send, or delete. Sending and deleting require explicit user intent.
